world 0 (key mothballed).reader_note: Shut down and stored untouched in reserve means mothballed; untouched kills patched and repackaged.

world 1 (key patched).reader_note: Fixing flaws with a few lines of code = patched; kept running, old name, instead of buying kill the rest.

world 2 (key outsourced).reader_note: Paid an outside firm to run it = outsourced; kept running, old name and no code changed kill mothballed, repackaged, patched.

world 3 (key repackaged).reader_note: New name and screen, code unchanged; kept running, own program, no line changed kill the rest.

world 1 (key pioneer).reader_note: First ever and copied by all means pioneer; dealing directly and forwarding complaints kill middleman and referee.

world 2 (key publicist).reader_note: Paid feature videos = publicist; direct dealing, no part in disputes, and decades-old approach each kill one distractor.

world 3 (key referee).reader_note: Both sides accept its rulings = referee; national companies, direct dealing and the alphabetical list kill pioneer, middleman, publicist.

world 0 (key middleman).reader_note: Passes orders on and keeps a cut; forwards complaints, alphabetical listing, national firms earlier kill the rest.

world 2 (key retroactive).reader_note: Billing back to January before the vote gives retroactive; line-by-line, larger homes pay more, and just covering cost kill the rest.

world 3 (key opaque).reader_note: Single number, confidential formula = opaque; just covered cost, larger homes paid more, next month's pickup kill the rest.

world 0 (key punitive).reader_note: A charge ten times the cost meant to deter = punitive; line-by-line bills, next-month start and higher charges for larger homes kill opaque, retroactive, regressive.

world 1 (key regressive).reader_note: Flat fee takes largest share from poorest; next month, line by line, just covered cost kill the rest.

world 3 (key overreach).reader_note: Applying beyond its authority and being struck down means overreach; experiment, steady prices, no other fishery kill the rest.

world 0 (key precedent).reader_note: Cited later as proof such laws survive court = precedent; courts upheld kills overreach, rarely mattered kills remedy, pledge only implicit.

world 1 (key pledge).reader_note: Presented as a promise to stand behind fishers = pledge; no other fishery, 'rarely mattered' and court approval kill precedent, remedy, overreach.

world 2 (key remedy).reader_note: Restored incomes then repealed, job done; no other fishery, courts upheld kill precedent, overreach.

world 0 (key proprietary).reader_note: Secret code and lawsuits mean proprietary; interlocked, crashing, most-advanced kill modular, resilient, outmoded.

world 1 (key modular).reader_note: Separate swappable parts = modular; one fault crashed all, freely shared, most advanced kill the rest.

world 2 (key resilient).reader_note: Survived crashes that broke rivals = resilient; freely shared, most advanced and tightly interlocked kill proprietary, outmoded, modular.

world 3 (key outmoded).reader_note: Copied abandoned design and lagged; interlocked, freely shared, crashed kill modular, proprietary, resilient.

world 1 (key privatized).reader_note: Routes handed to a private company that owns them means privatized; all twelve, same streets, district pays kill the rest.

world 2 (key redrawn).reader_note: Same twelve routes on different streets = redrawn; ran itself, all twelve kept, savings from fuel kill the rest.

world 3 (key monetized).reader_note: Sold ads and charged fares = monetized; ran it itself, same streets and all twelve routes kill privatized, redrawn, pared.

world 0 (key pared).reader_note: Cut three of twelve routes; same streets, ran them itself kill redrawn and privatized.

world 2 (key observer).reader_note: Attended, took notes, never spoke means observer; existing committee and chair bargaining kill the others.

world 3 (key mentor).reader_note: Private coaching of the chair = mentor; chair did bargaining, committee already formed, stayed away kill the rest.

world 0 (key negotiator).reader_note: Director bargained on their behalf = negotiator; the existing committee kills organizer and sitting across kills observer, but mentor is never directly contradicted.

world 1 (key organizer).reader_note: Knocked on doors and ran meetings then withdrew; spokespeople bargained, so not negotiator or observer.

world 3 (key misleading).reader_note: Flyer omitted costs twice the laptop price, so misleading; never returned, once, small kill the rest.

world 0 (key prohibitive).reader_note: More than most families could pay = prohibitive; paid once, nothing returned, matched to the cent kill the rest.

world 1 (key recurring).reader_note: Billed again every September = recurring; each distractor is denied in the same sentence.

world 2 (key refundable).reader_note: Full amount returned; billed once, matched flyer, small enough kill recurring, misleading, prohibitive.
